warnings.message: Localbox's sandbox service isn't running, so sandboxes on this Mac can't start or answer.
warnings.fix: Localbox keeps restarting it; if this lasts, quit Localbox and open it again.

warnings.message: This Mac isn't signed in, so other computers and cloud agents can't reach its sandboxes.
warnings.fix: Sign in from Settings, or run localbox login --email you@example.com.

warnings.message: The built-in Linux image isn't on this Mac, so new Linux sandboxes can't start.
warnings.fix: Quit Localbox and open it again to download it, or run localbox app image ensure.

warnings.message: While this Mac is locked, idle sandboxes can't free their memory, because the lock screen asks for a password.
warnings.fix: System Settings > Lock Screen: set "Require password after screen saver begins or display is turned off" to Never

warnings.message: Localbox isn't in your Applications folder, so it can't open at login or install the localbox command.
warnings.fix: Move Localbox to the Applications folder and open it from there.

warnings.message: Localbox won't open at login until you allow it.
warnings.fix: In System Settings > General > Login Items, turn on Localbox.

warnings.message: The localbox command isn't installed, so agents on this Mac can't run it.
warnings.fix: Quit Localbox and open it again to install it.
